question: how many episodes would make the completion rates informative, and what would that cost
approach: plan for precision rather than significance, because a block can reach significance on one comparison and still leave every rate too wide to act on
fixture_strengthened: a mutation removing the rate-range guard still raised, from a square root of a negative number, so the fixture now asserts why the error was raised

inputs.planning_rate_source: the lowest observed completion rate, which needs the most episodes
inputs.cost_source: the executed confirmation block receipt, not an assumed price

decision_taken: the extra episodes were not run in this cycle. A third repeat would cost about one dollar and move the half width from 0.327 to roughly 0.29, which does not change what can be concluded, so the requirement is recorded and the spend is put to the user as a question with a default of not spending.
